items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: he had from country, spirituals, to opera, Lawrence Tibbett and I always recall her name, but Lily Pons.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. It was like a life thing.

And that’s where I became — it struck a chord here. And that’s it, I said I knew what I wanted to do. Which actually it was an affirmation really, and a confirmation. Because at home, before even getting into school, when I was like four and five years old — two and say three, after — I was born in Birmingham, Alabama but I came there when I was about three years old, two and a half to three years. But anyway, my uncle, in Buffalo, New York, had all the records. And the word — I didn’t know it then, but — he was…
You never thought you’d say that, did you?
